newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Cepsa 9-month profit falls 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Cepsa 9-month profit falls 24 pct.

text.p: Results for Spanish oil firm Cepsa for the first nine months of 1996, in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE: The company said group investment until September had reached 42 billion pesetas.
The price of Brent crude, which was 15 percent higher during the period than a year earlier, and Spain's system of fixing prices had impacted the refinery division, the company said.

In the petrochemicals division, although sales were roughly flat compared with a year earlier, the company said margins were hit by the rise in crude oil prices, an increase in raw material costs and the fall in sales prices effected in the previous months.
